test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following regions in India is nicknamed as the storehouse of minerals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chota Nagpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Chota Nagpur Plateau** in India has earned the moniker **"storehouse of minerals"** due to its abundant mineral wealth.
 
• Comprised primarily of igneous rocks dating back to the Pre-Cambrian era, this plateau boasts a rich array of resources including mica, bauxite, copper, limestone, iron ore, and coal.
 
• Spanning across the states of Jharkhand, Odisha, West Bengal, and Chhattisgarh, the Chota Nagpur Plateau sustains a populace whose primary occupation revolves around mining activities. 
 
• The Chota Nagpur Dry Deciduous Forests provide a habitat for a range of endangered species, including tigers, sloth bears, leopards, blackbucks, Asian elephants, and chinkaras. 
 
• Additionally, these forests harbour significant species of conservation concern, such as the lesser Florican and two species of hornbills.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The expansive Deccan Plateau** in southern India is situated between the Western Ghats and the Eastern Ghats, generally delineated as the peninsular area south of the Narmada River.
 
• **The Western Ghats,** also referred to as the Sahyadri mountain range, sprawls across an expanse of 160,000 km², stretching approximately 1,600 km parallel to the western coastline of the Indian peninsula. This range traverses through the states of Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu.
 
• **The Himalayas,** often simply called the Himalayas, form a formidable mountain range in Asia, acting as a natural barrier separating the plains of the Indian subcontinent from the Tibetan Plateau.
